captureMethod: Capture-only scratch project; SessionStart, SessionEnd, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop, and PostCompaction wired with blank matchers to a logger that wrote one JSON stdin event per file and emitted no stdout.
sanitization: Replace project paths and host identity with semantic placeholders.
Replace session, prompt, tool-use, agent, and shell identifiers with stable semantic placeholders while preserving correlation.
Remove timestamps and non-load-bearing task, report, prompt, tool-schema, reasoning, and generated-workflow content.
Preserve native field names, nesting, booleans, missing-versus-null distinctions, response status, and classifier strings used by deterministic tests.
limits: Interactive panel cancellation and Ctrl+B were not captured.
A session export is conversation evidence, not independent hook stdin.
The still-running and exited-with-error read strings used by tests are binary-pinned, not present in these captured events.
